text_block_list.text:
Right after summer camp, during our training,
I decided to arrange a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun. Today's opponent is...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo, Hayahide! Today's our showdown!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Trainer. Are you sure you want to run with her?
Revealing your hand right before the Kikuka-sho—
choice_data_list: Because I felt like things couldn't stay the way they were.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Do you understand?
What is missing from my equation, into which I have factored even my own resolve?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me.
That race was meant to help us figure that out, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
......I'll be ready right away.
There's no way I'm losing.
And so, the match between Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide began.

The race shifted right after the fourth corner,
just as they entered the home stretch—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(—There's plenty of distance between her and Ticket.
Her final stretch burst is terrifying, but according to all the data, a lead like this should be safe.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nu, nununu~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Wh-What, spurting already? It's too early!
Your stamina will never hold out! You're bound
to run out of steam before the final 200 meters!)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(...A gamble like that won't break my theory.
If I maintain this pace
and make my move again at the end—)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOH---!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(—However, I am still ahead.
It's fine, only 300 meters left. I can hold the lead.
Even after Ticket decelerated, there's plenty of...)
choice_data_list: Hayahide has to make her move too!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Go on the attack or not...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugggh... WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!
I'm gonna WIIIIIIIIINNNNN!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
(Huh...? Why... are you next to me?
No, ahead of me...?)
—Winning Ticket overtook Biwa Hayahide and dove across the finish line in first place.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...*pant*... *gasp*...!
Damn it... Why am I...!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Phew, Hayahide! Wanna race again!?
'Cause leaving things on a loss feels the worst!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Still, I want to win too! I'm not backing down in the next race either!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright, alright, that's enough, runaway girl.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wah, Taishin!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's got their own pace, ya know.
If you've got energy to burn, wanna
be my running partner?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's get going!
...See you later, Hayahide.
That was just as I tried to hand Biwa Hayahide a drink after cooling down.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...A moment ago, you told me,
'You have to go on the offensive.'

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I finally get it. That's the "difference."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"It wasn't that I failed to attack;
I had fallen into playing defense. Unlike them."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...In order not to lose.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Looking back, it wasn't just earlier. All along, they had been saying, "I want to win," while I kept saying, "I won't lose."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even the winning formula that had been built up
since childhood in the first place—

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text:
Wah!! Brian-chan is
even fastーーer than Hayahide-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Child's Parent
text_block_list.text:
It's true! Little Brian is amazing~.
I wonder if she has an even more promising future than her big sister~.

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
I can get faster too...!
Even faster, more and more...!

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't... lose to Brian...!!
(Craaaash!!)

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Big sis!?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Lost again...
*sniff*..."

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But next time for sure...! I'll formulate a winning
equation that no one can beat...!
I won't let that girl—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
—The "formula for victory" was born from
a simple desire: "I don't want to lose."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...It's contradictory, isn't it, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It is only natural that Ticket and the others
leaped beyond the scope of my theories.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They desire to 'win,'
and even if the path to victory is razor-thin,
they have stayed on the offensive to seize 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's fundamentally different.
There's no way that equation applies.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, why was I putting together a defensive equation just to 'avoid losing',
even while calling it a Winning Equation...?!"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And I'm only noticing something like this now.
Even though I...!
choice_data_list: If it was wrong, then we just have to correct it.

text_block_list.text:
—If she were the kind of horse girl
who would give up on her dreams over this...

"When my little sister surpassed me, when I got injured,
I'm sure I would have stopped running."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: However, that means building everything back up almost from scratch.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The fundamentals are completely different. We'll have to reconsider everything we've built up so far.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Besides, there's little time left until the Kikuka Sho.
In other words, I'll be taking up your free time as well."
choice_data_list: Still, you want to win the Kikuka Sho, right?
Still, you want to win the Kikuka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ......You're an idiot.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet I am the even greater fool.
Fool enough to take your gesture as a form of salvation.
And so, resuming training that very day to rebuild our winning formula—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah. Hayahide, you really came!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ticket...? Why are you still here...?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, Taishin said you'd show up if we just waited!
Right, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I wasn't waiting. I just thought we could run
together once Ticket finished her rest.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ah! Taishin, you're being so contrary~~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm going ahead to run.
If you want to run too, Hayahide, be my guest.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. We might be rivals,
but we're friends first!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If something's troubling you, don't bottle it up
and think about it alone—let us help too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It seems my perspective was far too narrow. Moving forward, I'll need to... broaden it.

As if chasing after the two of them,
Biwa Hayahide sprinted out onto the track.
